recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, clinical MRI cross-section of a human skull centered on a pitch-black background, featuring a subtle geometric pattern overlaid on the brain tissue and technical measurement markings.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical organic skull structure against a void-like background
Cyan-tinted highlights contrasting with deep black shadows
Clinical typography balanced at the top corners of the frame
Technical measurement scales framing the central biological subject
coreInvariants: Cyan-blue and white color palette on black
Axial view of a human head scan
High-grain, film-like texture over the digital image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered axial brain scan occupying 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, detailed nasal and orbital cavities in the upper center of the skull.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright central scan, move upward to the corner text, then down to the technical scales.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the central scan to emphasize isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan and white for the scan details and bone structure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal for the geometric brain overlay and technical markings.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast; the image relies on luminosity rather than color variety.

letterConstructionRules: Consistent stroke weight in the lowercase display text
Sharp, bracketed serifs for the uppercase title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a closed loop and stylized descender
Uniformly thin serifs on the uppercase 'A' and 'Y'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between lowercase slab-serif and uppercase traditional serif for a modern-clinical feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the slab-serif clinical typewriter aesthetic.
Provides the sharp, traditional serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast MRI axial brain scan centered on a black background. Apply a cyan-blue tint to the highlights. Include a subtle, faded geometric knot pattern on the lower brain tissue and thin white measurement tick marks on the bottom and right edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase slab-serif text in the top-left corner and wide-tracked uppercase serif text in the top-right corner using white and light cyan colors.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly cyan, white, and black?
Are the measurement scales present on the edges?
Is the text positioned in the extreme top corners?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the geometric brain overlay
Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Exact alphanumeric codes on the right scale

mustAchieve: Clinical medical accuracy in scan appearance
avoid: Warm colors like red or yellow

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the black background
Check that the scan doesn't look like a 3D model but a 2D slice
Verify the symmetry of the skull structure
Confirm the presence of the subtle grain texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Clinical MRI Scan + Cyan Monochrome + Corner-Balanced Serif Typography + Technical Measurement Overlays
